name: 31757 · Thomasville, GA
findings: ZIP 31757 (Thomasville) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31757 (Thomasville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
